bipartite_relation.note: There exists a Boolean vertex map separating every pair related by the arbitrary finite relation. No symmetry, irreflexivity, inhabited-carrier or palette-surjectivity premise. Convertible to the existing simple-graph bipartite predicate.

bipartition_parts.note: Two supplied disjoint sets cover every vertex and each directed arc crosses between them. Empty parts are permitted; equivalent to the supplied upstream bipartition under the disjoint-cover conditions.

balanced_bipartition.note: Two supplied disjoint covering parts both have exactly n vertices, and every arc crosses. n=0 is permitted; positivity stays at callers.

bipartition_sizes.note: Two existential disjoint covering parts have exact independently prescribed cardinalities a and b, and every arc has one end in each via Prop disjunction. Empty parts and the empty graph are permitted.

bipartite_after_deletion.note: The graph del_edge_set G S has an upstream supplied-side witness. S is an arbitrary family of vertex sets; only actual two-vertex edges are removed. No edge-subset premise is added.
